# DeepBridge Advisory — extended company briefing

## Positioning

DeepBridge supports industrial businesses through SAP transformation, operational improvement and interim leadership. We bring together experienced professionals, define the assignment and stay involved through delivery, coordination and handover.

European focus: London · Munich · Madrid, with particular attention to industrial programmes in Germany. These cities describe strategic focus. They are not a claim of three physical offices.

Canonical website: https://deepbridgeadvisory.com/
German website: https://deepbridgeadvisory.com/de
Spanish website: https://deepbridgeadvisory.com/es

## Registered entity

The website operator is DEEPBRIDGE ADVISORY LTD, company number 16775578, incorporated on 9 October 2025 and registered in England and Wales. The registered office is 71–75 Shelton Street, Covent Garden, London WC2H 9JQ, United Kingdom.

Company details are separate from the European strategic focus. The company does not present itself as a law firm, tax adviser, immigration adviser or provider of employment-status advice.

## Expertise

1. SAP & Business Transformation: specialist support for SAP S/4HANA programmes, business processes, planning and process improvement, business analysis, operational data and Power BI reporting, and workstream coordination.
2. Operations & Supply Chain: experienced professionals supporting production and operations leadership, supply chain planning, customer service and order-to-delivery, inventory, logistics and operational stabilisation.
3. Interim Leadership & Finance: senior capability for change, delivery pressure and temporary leadership needs, including interim management, finance and controlling, programme and project leadership, transformation PMO and operational coordination.

The detailed requirement, availability and suitable expertise are assessed for each assignment. Listed areas are possible assignments, not a claim of completed DeepBridge experience in every discipline. No SAP partner status, certification or guaranteed business outcome is claimed.

## Engagement process

1. Define: clarify the requirement, scope, expected outputs, working model and client dependencies.
2. Assemble: identify professionals whose experience and availability match the assignment.
3. Mobilise: align responsibilities, engagement arrangements, onboarding and reporting.
4. Oversee: maintain agreed progress reviews, coordinate issues and manage changes as the work develops.
5. Transition: plan handover, knowledge transfer and continuity, including replacement coordination where required.

The level of DeepBridge involvement is agreed for each assignment. DeepBridge can support an individual specialist assignment, several complementary professionals, or an agreed project work package or coordination mandate. The applicable written agreement defines the actual engagement and responsibilities.

DeepBridge remains involved beyond the initial introduction. The assignment can include a named contact, clear communication and responsibilities, agreed progress reviews, practical issue and change coordination, and planned handover and replacement coordination when needed.

Client enquiries: https://deepbridgeadvisory.com/contact?type=client#contact-form
How We Work: https://deepbridgeadvisory.com/for-clients

## Professional network

DeepBridge works with experienced independent professionals and interim managers across SAP, operations, supply chain, data, finance and programme leadership. Professionals should provide relevant expertise, location, languages, availability and useful professional background. The public form is not a channel for sensitive identity, banking or tax documents.

Opportunities are assessed against the assignment, experience, availability, working model and expectations. Joining the network does not guarantee an assignment or create an employment relationship. Engagement arrangements are discussed for each assignment and defined in the applicable written agreement.

For Professionals: https://deepbridgeadvisory.com/for-consultants
Join the network: https://deepbridgeadvisory.com/contact?type=consultant#contact-form
Opportunities: https://deepbridgeadvisory.com/opportunities

## Geography

The European proposition centres on London, Munich and Madrid, with Germany a particular focus. The existing wider network also relates to programmes in the UK, Spain, the DACH region, the United States, Central America and South America. This describes markets and networks, not a physical office in every location.

Cross-border engagements may raise assignment-specific questions about contracting, work location, immigration, taxation, social security, insurance, data handling or employment status. Appropriately qualified advisers should review those questions where required.

## Deutsch: Unternehmen und Zusammenarbeit

DeepBridge verbindet die Anforderungen industrieller Projekte mit erfahrenen Fachleuten und einer praxisnahen Begleitung der Umsetzung. Wir unterstützen Unternehmen bei SAP-Transformationen, operativen Verbesserungen und temporärem Führungsbedarf. Europäischer Fokus: London · München · Madrid, mit besonderem Augenmerk auf Industrieprojekte in Deutschland.

Unsere drei Leistungsbereiche sind SAP & Unternehmenstransformation, Operations & Supply Chain sowie Interim Management & Finance. Welche Expertise verfügbar ist und wie der Auftrag ausgestaltet wird, klären wir im Einzelfall.

Die Zusammenarbeit umfasst fünf Schritte: Auftrag klären, Expertise zusammenstellen, Einsatz vorbereiten, Umsetzung begleiten und Übergabe sichern. Der Umfang unserer Begleitung wird für jeden Auftrag individuell vereinbart. DeepBridge bleibt nach der Vorstellung der Experten eingebunden und stimmt Fortschrittsgespräche, Eskalationen und Kontinuität mit dem Kunden ab.

## Español: empresa y colaboración

DeepBridge conecta las necesidades de proyectos industriales con profesionales experimentados y una coordinación práctica de la ejecución. Apoyamos a empresas en transformaciones SAP, mejoras operativas y necesidades temporales de liderazgo. Enfoque europeo: Londres · Múnich · Madrid, con especial atención a los programas industriales en Alemania.

Nuestras tres áreas son SAP y transformación empresarial, operaciones y cadena de suministro, y dirección interina y finanzas. La disponibilidad de especialistas, el alcance y los entregables se evalúan para cada encargo.

La colaboración se articula en cinco pasos: definir el encargo, reunir la experiencia adecuada, preparar la incorporación, acompañar la ejecución y organizar el traspaso. El grado de participación de DeepBridge se acuerda en cada caso. Mantenemos nuestra implicación tras la presentación de los profesionales y acordamos con el cliente las revisiones de progreso, el escalado de incidencias y la continuidad.

Trabajamos con profesionales independientes y directivos interinos con experiencia en SAP, operaciones, cadena de suministro, datos, finanzas y dirección de programas. Para valorar un posible encargo son relevantes la experiencia, la ubicación, los idiomas y la disponibilidad. Incorporarse a la red no garantiza un proyecto ni crea una relación laboral.

## Published guidance / Veröffentlichte Beiträge / Artículos publicados

### How to define a transformation consultant requirement

A strong brief leads with the delivery outcome, explains programme stage and constraints, distinguishes essential experience from useful signals, and makes decision authority, working model, location and timing explicit.

English: https://deepbridgeadvisory.com/insights/defining-transformation-consultant-requirement
Deutsch: https://deepbridgeadvisory.com/de/insights/defining-transformation-consultant-requirement
Español: https://deepbridgeadvisory.com/es/insights/defining-transformation-consultant-requirement

### When an SAP programme needs independent specialist support

Independent support can add value when a critical workstream lacks experienced ownership, business and technology teams are not reaching decisions, the programme enters a higher-risk phase, or recovery needs an objective view. The remit, decision rights, success measures and knowledge-transfer expectations should be clear.

English: https://deepbridgeadvisory.com/insights/when-sap-programme-needs-independent-specialist-support
Deutsch: https://deepbridgeadvisory.com/de/insights/when-sap-programme-needs-independent-specialist-support
Español: https://deepbridgeadvisory.com/es/insights/when-sap-programme-needs-independent-specialist-support

### Building cross-border transformation teams

Cross-border teams should be designed around programme outcomes, decision coverage, stakeholder access, location and working patterns. Engagement constraints should be identified early, with one shared governance and reporting rhythm across countries.

English: https://deepbridgeadvisory.com/insights/building-cross-border-transformation-teams-uk-europe
Deutsch: https://deepbridgeadvisory.com/de/insights/building-cross-border-transformation-teams-uk-europe
Español: https://deepbridgeadvisory.com/es/insights/building-cross-border-transformation-teams-uk-europe
